title: laug · gates
description: Every gate the store holds, and the A/A band over days: which gate to open, how the runs ended, whether an unchanged release drifts, the fault's shape, time to verdict, the host's wave pressure and R7's d per gate. Every number is a record, copied from a gate's own files; the band's gates are a committed list, _obs/aa/<list>.txt. Times are UTC.

list.name: host
list.label: host type
list.description: The host type of the list's own gates; the other gates drawn beside the list's are of this type.

list.name: reading
list.label: readings
list.description: The readings drawn one panel each, as load/steady-state.yaml names them.

panels.title: Every gate the store holds, newest first
Gates
panels.description: One row a gate, from its records (laug_gate_info, laug_gate_verdict, the clock and the A/A lists), fake gates left out. A gate id opens laug · gate run with the gate's window, t0 less 30 s to its last timeline line (done) plus 30 s. The verdict is copied from verdict.json.

panels.title: How many runs a day, and how they ended
Gates a day, by verdict (verdict.json)
panels.description: Each bar counts the gates whose verdict.json the store holds in the 24 h ending at the bar's right edge, 00:00 UTC.

panels.title: BLOCKs by class (verdict.json)
panels.description: The BLOCKed gates in the range, by their verdict.json class.

panels.title: The A/A band: an unchanged release across days, from the committed list
The A/A band per reading, over the chosen list (record)
panels.description: The steady item's whole-window readings of the list's gates (their verdict JSONs), and the fault item pl's before and after windows (raun JSONs): lowest, highest and how many gates. The list is a committed file, _obs/aa/<list>.txt, never a filter on verdicts. Units: ms, but the error rate (a share) and completions (workflows).

defaults.noValue: no gate of this list in the range

targets.expr: min by (item, window, reading) ((last_over_time(laug_item_reading{item="steady", window="whole", reading=~"workflow_task_schedule_to_start_p99_ms|activity_schedule_to_start_p99_ms|workflow_end_to_end_p95_ms|persistence_latency_p99_ms|service_error_rate|frontend_request_p99_ms|workflows_completed"}[$__range]) or last_over_time(laug_item_reading{item="pl", window=~"before|after", reading=~"workflow_task_schedule_to_start_p99_ms|activity_schedule_to_start_p99_ms|workflow_end_to_end_p95_ms|persistence_latency_p99_ms|service_error_rate|frontend_request_p99_ms"}[$__range])) and on(gate_id) last_over_time(laug_aa{list="$aa"}[$__range]))

max by (item, window, reading) ((last_over_time(laug_item_reading{item="steady", window="whole", reading=~"workflow_task_schedule_to_start_p99_ms|activity_schedule_to_start_p99_ms|workflow_end_to_end_p95_ms|persistence_latency_p99_ms|service_error_rate|frontend_request_p99_ms|workflows_completed"}[$__range]) or last_over_time(laug_item_reading{item="pl", window=~"before|after", reading=~"workflow_task_schedule_to_start_p99_ms|activity_schedule_to_start_p99_ms|workflow_end_to_end_p95_ms|persistence_latency_p99_ms|service_error_rate|frontend_request_p99_ms"}[$__range])) and on(gate_id) last_over_time(laug_aa{list="$aa"}[$__range]))

count by (item, window, reading) ((last_over_time(laug_item_reading{item="steady", window="whole", reading=~"workflow_task_schedule_to_start_p99_ms|activity_schedule_to_start_p99_ms|workflow_end_to_end_p95_ms|persistence_latency_p99_ms|service_error_rate|frontend_request_p99_ms|workflows_completed"}[$__range]) or last_over_time(laug_item_reading{item="pl", window=~"before|after", reading=~"workflow_task_schedule_to_start_p99_ms|activity_schedule_to_start_p99_ms|workflow_end_to_end_p95_ms|persistence_latency_p99_ms|service_error_rate|frontend_request_p99_ms"}[$__range])) and on(gate_id) last_over_time(laug_aa{list="$aa"}[$__range]))

panels.title: The A/A list (record)
panels.description: Per committed list: its gates in the range, the BLOCKs among them, and with 0 BLOCKs of n the 95% upper bound on the rate at which an unchanged release BLOCKs, 1 - 0.05^(1/n). The list was chosen once and is never rebuilt from verdicts, so the panel lists BLOCKs and calls none false.

defaults.noValue: no list's gate in this range

targets.expr: count by (list) (last_over_time(laug_gate_verdict{verdict="BLOCK"}[$__range]) and on(gate_id) last_over_time(laug_aa[$__range])) or 0 * count by (list) (last_over_time(laug_aa[$__range]))

(1 - 0.05 ^ (1 / count by (list) (last_over_time(laug_aa[$__range])))) unless on (list) count by (list) (last_over_time(laug_gate_verdict{verdict="BLOCK"}[$__range]) and on(gate_id) last_over_time(laug_aa[$__range]))

panels.title: $reading, the steady item, one point a gate (record)
panels.description: Each gate's steady reading from its verdict JSON, one point a gate at its own time: water, the gates of the chosen A/A list; silica, the other gates on the chosen host type. Ember points: each gate's own max from its thresholds.json. Has an unchanged release drifted across days, hosts or trees.

targets.expr: max(laug_item_reading{item="steady", window="whole", reading="$reading"} and on(gate_id) laug_aa{list="$aa"})
max(laug_item_reading{item="steady", window="whole", reading="$reading"} unless on(gate_id) laug_aa{list="$aa"} and on(gate_id) laug_gate_info{host_type="$host", fake="false"})
max(laug_threshold{reading="$reading"} and on(gate_id) laug_item_reading{item="steady", window="whole", reading="$reading"})

panels.title: Per gate: completions, the fault's shape, time to verdict, the host, R7
Workflows completed, the steady item, one point a gate (record)
panels.description: Each gate's steady completions. The verdict's floor is 0.95 x the plan's rate x its duration (load/verdict.sh): 5 700 for steady at 20/s for 5 m; follow copies no duration, so the board draws no floor.

targets.expr: max(laug_item_reading{item="steady", window="whole", reading="workflows_completed"} and on(gate_id) laug_aa{list="$aa"})
max(laug_item_reading{item="steady", window="whole", reading="workflows_completed"} unless on(gate_id) laug_aa{list="$aa"})

panels.title: The fault's shape: inject to landed, remove to recovered (record, s)
panels.description: Each gate's fault item, from its four marks (raun JSON): does persistence-latency keep its shape.

targets.expr: max by (item) (laug_fault_mark_seconds{mark="landed", fake!="true"} - ignoring (mark) laug_fault_mark_seconds{mark="inject", fake!="true"})
max by (item) (laug_fault_mark_seconds{mark="recovered", fake!="true"} - ignoring (mark) laug_fault_mark_seconds{mark="remove", fake!="true"})

panels.title: The fault's failed iterations in its during window (record)
panels.description: Work the clients lost while the fault held, per gate (raun JSON).

panels.title: Time to verdict and harness-test's share (record, s)
panels.description: verdict.json's elapsed_s, t0 to post, and harness.json's seconds, per gate. Dashed: 900 s, the 15 min a gate was built to finish in.

panels.title: Wave pressure per gate: the mean of its polls' io some (record, %)
panels.description: The mean over each gate's poll.jsonl lines of io some avg10, as recorded. Water: the chosen A/A list's gates; silica: the others.

targets.expr: max by (gate_id) (avg_over_time(laug_gate_poll_pressure{resource="io", kind="some", fake!="true"}[$__range])) and on(gate_id) last_over_time(laug_aa{list="$aa"}[$__range])
max by (gate_id) (avg_over_time(laug_gate_poll_pressure{resource="io", kind="some", fake!="true"}[$__range])) unless on(gate_id) last_over_time(laug_aa{list="$aa"}[$__range])

panels.title: R7 per gate: d per compared reading in ms (verdict.json)
panels.description: Each gate's comparison rows' d, release minus incumbent, for the readings in ms; dashed ember: the tolerances in the gate's thresholds.json (absent in recording mode).

defaults.noValue: no gate with an incumbent in this range

panels.title: R7 per gate: d per compared share (verdict.json)
panels.description: The same for the three shares.

defaults.noValue: no gate with an incumbent in this range
